name: Persona
notes: Persona is a personal AI assistant that works over iMessage and a web dashboard, making calls, booking appointments, handling returns, forms, invoices and subscription cancellations, and coming back with confirmations. It is also pre-selling Persona Band, a wearable wristband front-end for the same assistant that ships December 2026. Requested via the form (issue #310).

access.price: Assistant free to use (site FAQ: "Using Persona is free"); Persona Band $179 pre-order (from $219), ships December 2026
